{
  "conventions": [
    "Format with Prettier defaults (80 cols, 2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas all, semicolons) and satisfy ESLint with --max-warnings=0.",
    "Follow ESLint import/order: external packages first, then @excalidraw/* packages, then relative imports, with import type declarations separated by a blank line at the bottom of each group.",
    "Do not access global window or document in editor runtime code; use app.ownerDocument / app.ownerWindow when DOM globals are needed.",
    "Use Merge<Base, Overrides> from @excalidraw/common/utility-types instead of Omit<Base, ...> & Overrides when overriding fields on union or element types.",
    "Add new UI translation strings only to packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json and reference them via t(\"labels.<key>\")."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "Arrowhead size constants and type",
      "choice": "Export ARROWHEAD_SIZES = { sm: 0.5, md: 0.75, lg: 1, xl: 1.25 } as const, type ArrowheadSize = (typeof ARROWHEAD_SIZES)[keyof typeof ARROWHEAD_SIZES], DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE: ArrowheadSize = ARROWHEAD_SIZES.lg, and isValidArrowheadSize(value: unknown): value is ArrowheadSize from packages/common/src/constants.ts, and re-export ArrowheadSize from packages/element/src/types.ts.",
      "rejected": [
        "Fixed pixel presets shared across all arrowhead types",
        "String preset keys requiring a lookup table at every geometry call site"
      ],
      "reason": "Each arrowhead type has its own base pixel size (25, 12, 15, 20), so numeric scale multipliers (with lg = 1 as default) scale all arrowhead types proportionally while matching FONT_SIZES and RadioSelection ergonomics."
    },
    {
      "topic": "Element property and default-key omission",
      "choice": "Add optional arrowheadSize?: ArrowheadSize on ExcalidrawLinearElement; omit arrowheadSize whenever it is undefined, not a valid ArrowheadSize preset, or equal to DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE (1) in newLinearElement, newArrowEleme
